question: How do I access documentation insights and improvement recommendations from Fern?
ground_truth: Fern provides insights by analyzing Ask Fern query patterns to identify documentation gaps and generate improvement suggestions. After collecting query data for a month, Fern processes query-response pairs through specialized models to extract common themes and provide actionable recommendations. This feature is currently in development and not generally available - you need to email support@buildwithfern.com to get started. Once available, insights are delivered as a monthly report directly by the Fern team.

metadata.cited_context: Fern analyzes Ask Fern query patterns to surface actionable recommendations for improving your documentation. After collecting sufficient query data over a month, Fern processes this through specialized models that analyze query-response pairs to identify documentation gaps, extract common themes, and generate specific suggestions for enhancing your docs. This feature is currently not yet generally available. Please email us at support@buildwithfern.com to get started. Insights are currently provided as a monthly report delivered directly by the Fern team.
